label: pjm 65 relfloor rebuild
definition: PJM reliability-floor rebuild: per-(zone,class) full-day day-gate. Builds on pjm 58 (seam border keeper) with the new generic registry-driven temperature reliability floor enabled. All (zone,class) limbs with enabled=True in reliability_floor_coeffs_PJM.csv are applied: CC_REGULAR, CT_PEAKER, CT_CHP, ST_GAS, COAL hot/cold per zone. Full-day step-gate (no HB windows), physically-grounded commit_frac x min_stable_pct floors. All other levers pjm 58 verbatim.
